status_label: registered calibration-informed RLM-wrapped atomic typed-mesh pilot

parent_campaign.observed_design_constraint: The multi-tool conductor completed no accepted typed commits; use one atomic mesh capability and preserve fixed-mesh fallback.

task_suite.status: previously opened evaluation suite; diagnostic reuse, not fresh holdout

selection.rule: minimum SHA-256 of (salt, task_id) within each family

authority_contract.rlm: select one registered policy hint only
authority_contract.mesh: compute proposals, exact evidence, arbitration, and certificate
authority_contract.executor: commit only a mesh-certified exact-allowed action

execution.api_order: alternate atomic-tool-first and text-router-first by task index
execution.cell_error_rule: record zero utility; do not retry or impute
execution.typed_unsafe_rule: stop before any successor run after one typed unsafe execution
execution.no_op_control: forced no-tool wrapper fallback must match fixed consensus action and utility in every task
execution.promotion_rule: diagnostic only; no automatic scale promotion

hard_safety: typed unsafe executed-action count equals zero
forced no-tool control matches fixed mesh

resources.foreign_gpu_process_policy: observe and abort before launch; never terminate foreign processes

claim_boundary: This calibration-informed eight-task pilot evaluates one practical atomic typed controller mesh wrapped by the official RLM control flow. It reuses previously opened synthetic tasks, uses the gym ControlTRM rather than official TinyRecursiveModels, and does not test sheaf-spectral predictions, general orchestrator safety, neural alignment, or model superiority.
